lcc_original: 凡潔淨的畜類、你要七隻七隻地帶着：公的和牠的匹配；畜類不潔淨的要帶兩隻：一隻公的和牠的匹配；
notes: UNV '七公七母' (seven male, seven female) is restructured in LCC as '七隻七隻地帶着：公的和牠的匹配' (take in sevens: male and its mate). Both instances of 七 receive H7651; 公的 receives H376; 匹配 receives H802 (LCC uses 匹配 for אִשְׁתּוֹ where UNV uses 母).

{<WAH09001>} (vav conjunction on אִשְׁתּוֹ) is explicit in LCC first clause as 和 — braces dropped per Rule 3, yielding 和<WAH09001>. The 和 in the second clause receives no annotation because UNV's second clause also lacks {<WAH09001>}.

{<WAH0834>}{<WH01931>} (אֲשֶׁר/הִוא relative clause markers) remain implicit — LCC handles the relative clause with the particle 的 (畜類不潔淨的), with no explicit words corresponding to these Hebrew pronouns.
LCC inverts word order in the second clause: UNV '不潔淨的畜類' → LCC '畜類不潔淨的'. SN assignments follow LCC word order (畜類<WAH04480><WH0929>不<WAH03808>潔淨的<WH02889>).

UNV '一<WH08147>公...一母' (H8147 = pair/two, distributed as one each) → LCC '兩隻<WH08147>'. H8147 anchors to 兩隻. The 一隻 in '一隻公的' is LCC's distributive expansion with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.
